description: Connects your domain to Xellux: a TXT record proves that you own the domain, and a CNAME points a subdomain of your choice at Xellux, so your branded login (for example auth.example.com) and your booking page (for example termine.example.com) run on your own domain.
variableDescription: verifytxt: one-time verification code issued by Xellux for this domain. authhost: the subdomain to connect, for example 'auth' for the login or 'termine' for the booking page.
